'''Another Start''' (Korean: '''또 다른 시작''' ''Tto dareun sijak'') is the ending theme for the Korean dub of ''[[M08|Pokémon: Lucario and the Mystery of Mew]]''. It is performed by Kim Jieun. 

The song was added when the movie was re-dubbed in 2013, replacing the [[Song of Origin|Japanese ending theme song]] used in the previous dub.
